Brent emphasized reallocating 25% to 50% of Jake’s time for these deals to enhance revenue potential. They discussed creative pricing strategies that would allow customers to acquire specific enterprise features at lower costs, as well as the need for Jake to qualify enterprise features that matter most to potential clients. Additionally, tracking inbound leads generated from his outbound efforts was identified as a gap, affecting how Jake's contributions are credited. To improve outreach effectiveness, the team decided to shift engagement strategies for top accounts from cold calls to podcast invitations, aiming for stronger relationship building.
